subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Director's Legacy
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Director's Legacy.

hook.text: Some directors change cinema once. The legends change it repeatedly, across decades.

buildup.text: A director's legacy isn't just films — it's the filmmakers they inspire to pick up a camera.

discovery.text: Kurosawa inspired Lucas. The New Wave inspired New Hollywood. Each generation ignites the next.

twist.text: The next legendary director might be shooting on a phone right now, unknown.

climax.text: Cinema's greatest power is the chain of influence that connects every director who ever lived.

punchline.text: Every great film starts another filmmaker's career.

quiz.question: What is a director's most lasting legacy?
